name: Plainclause Withdrawal & Guarantee Notice
author: plainclause

sections.description:
Two EU consumer-law changes now apply to most online shops that sell to consumers in the EU:

  • Online withdrawal function (Article 11a of Directive 2011/83/EU, inserted by Directive (EU) 2023/2673, applicable from 19 June 2026). Consumers must be able to withdraw from an online contract through a clearly labelled function, a short withdrawal statement and a “confirm withdrawal” step, and must receive an acknowledgement of receipt on a durable medium.
  • Harmonised notice on the legal guarantee of conformity (Directive (EU) 2024/825 and Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1960, applicable from 27 September 2026). Traders inform consumers about the legal guarantee with an official notice that must not be edited.

This plugin adds both to WooCommerce, with no external services and no tracking.

Withdrawal function

  • A withdrawal page is created on activation, labelled “Withdraw from contract here” (editable, translatable).
  • Two steps, as the directive describes: the consumer enters or confirms their name, the order and the email for the confirmation, then presses “Confirm withdrawal”.
  • An acknowledgement email with the content of the statement and the date and time of submission is sent immediately (editable under WooCommerce > Settings > Emails).
  • The shop gets a notification email, an order note, and a list of all statements under WooCommerce > Withdrawals with a “Mark processed” action.
  • Logged-in customers pick their order from a list. Guests type the order number.
  • The button appears in the site footer, on eligible orders in My Account and in customer order emails (each optional), and anywhere with the [ewbgn_withdrawal_button] shortcode.
  • Statements are always accepted and recorded. Late statements are flagged for you, not blocked.
  • Works with High-Performance Order Storage and sequential order number plugins.

Legal guarantee notice

  • Shows the official notice image you select on product pages, the cart, the checkout or as a footer link, or anywhere with [ewbgn_guarantee_notice].
  • Display as a thumbnail or text link that opens the full notice in one click, or as the full notice.
  • Links to the official EUR-Lex language versions of the notice so you can pick the right language.

Important

This plugin is a tool, not legal advice. It does not make your shop compliant by itself: check the wording and the withdrawal period that apply in the countries you sell to, and your own terms. Some Member States prescribe specific wording for the button; you can change the labels in the settings.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > EU Withdrawal & Guarantee.
  3. Check the withdrawal page, the withdrawal period and the labels.
  4. For the notice: open the official notice in your language from the links on the settings page, save the colour image from Annex I, upload it to the Media Library, select it and enable the notice.
sections.faq:
Does the consumer have to give a reason?

No. The form asks only for what Article 11a lists: name, the contract (order) and the email for the confirmation. An optional field lets them name specific items.

What happens if the order number or email does not match?

The statement is still recorded and acknowledged, and the shop notification says it was not matched automatically, so a typo never blocks a valid withdrawal. You can switch on strict matching in the settings.

Does the plugin refund orders automatically?

No. Refunds and returns stay in your normal WooCommerce workflow. The statement is attached to the order as a note.

Can I translate the texts?

Yes. All texts are translatable, and the button and confirmation labels can be changed in the settings.

Does the plugin send data anywhere?

No. It makes no external requests. Statements are stored in your WordPress database.

Why do I have to upload the notice image myself?

The notice is an official image published by the European Union that must not be edited. You choose the language version that fits your shop.

1.0.1

  • Fix: the guarantee notice could appear twice on product pages in block themes.
  • Tweak: clearer form field styling.

1.0.0

  • First release: online withdrawal function with acknowledgement emails, statement log, and the harmonised legal guarantee notice display.

short_description: EU online withdrawal button with "confirm withdrawal" step and acknowledgement email, plus the EU legal guarantee notice, for WooCommerce.
